title: Alesteir
dek: A volatile companion who nevertheless insists that fallen enemies be treated as soldiers and presses on with the group.

facts.Journey: The search for Vey and Vaa
facts.Status: Reaches the refuge; broader personal history remains incomplete

sources: Quest RP refreshed source · supplied 23 October 2026 · 3,845 messages across the main channel and two accessible threads; posting chronology and narrated continuations remain distinct
body:
Alesteir travels with the party seeking Vey and Vaa. His irritation with Lucien and withdrawal from the group are visible parts of the expedition, alongside combat, restraint and respect for the dead.

Fighting and restraint

He warns about organizing watch before the ambush and is later caught asleep when it begins. Once awake, he fights through shadow and silence, with Zoroa aiding him. The account includes a moment when he resists a violent impulse rather than beheading a foe; the final prisoner is taken by Lucien.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5.

Respect after the fighting

He lays out the attackers’ bodies with their weapons and calls for them to be treated as soldiers who fought hard. Di’Trillio then makes shallow graves. Respect for the fallen does not turn the ambush into a justified attack or resolve why the surviving scout dies.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3.

Staying with the company

He stays near the party approaching the mountain camp, supports letting Di’Trillio speak and notices how small the refuge is for an uprising. The journey preserves his guardedness without inventing its cause or a permanent break with his companions.

Scene references: 1, 2, 3.
